# mtncloud_load_balancer_member (Data Source)

Looks up one member of a pool by ID or by name. Pick the load balancer and the pool by ID or name. A member's name is often empty; look it up by ID then, or list the pool's members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_network" "app" {
  name = "app-net"
}

data "mtncloud_load_balancer_member" "web1" {
  network_id         = data.mtncloud_network.app.id
  load_balancer_name = "web-lb"
  pool_name          = "web-pool"
  name               = "web-1"
}

output "web1_status" {
  value = data.mtncloud_load_balancer_member.web1.operating_status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) ID of the MTN Network the load balancer is on, for example `mtncloud_network.app.id`. Your tenant must own the network or have it shared with it.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The member's ID. Give this or `name`.
- `load_balancer_id` (String) Load balancer ID. Give this or `load_balancer_name`.
- `load_balancer_name` (String) Load balancer name, matched exactly; it must match exactly one on the network. Give this or `load_balancer_id`.
- `name` (String) The member's name, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.
- `pool_id` (String) The pool's ID. Give this or `pool_name`.
- `pool_name` (String) The pool's name, matched exactly. Give this or `pool_id`.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Backend IP address.
- `backup` (Boolean) Whether it gets traffic only when every other member is down.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is administratively up.
- `monitor_address` (String) Address the health monitor checks instead of `address`, or empty.
- `monitor_port` (Number) Port the health monitor checks instead of `port`, or 0.
- `operating_status` (String) `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE`, `DEGRADED`, `ERROR` or `NO_MONITOR`.
- `port` (Number) Backend port.
- `provisioning_status` (String) `ACTIVE`, or `PENDING_CREATE`, `PENDING_UPDATE`, `PENDING_DELETE` while a change is applied, or `ERROR`.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet the address is on, or empty for the load balancer's own.
- `weight` (Number) Share of traffic, 0 to 256; 0 sends it none.
